notes.title: Bridge to Yesterday just released for free!
notes.content:
After almost a year of development, Bridge to Yesterday has arrived on Steam! We spent at lot of time on this game, even though we chose to release it for free, but we are very proud of how polished the final product became. Teamwork became very hard during the last 6 months of development due to low morale from many members, but a couple of us was able to continue working on it. 

Originally, this game was a student project which we made for a course at the IT University of Copenhagen in Denmark. After we got an A+ on the project, myself and our Design Lead continued to work on the project with the intention of releasing it for free on Steam at the end of it. We had the fortune and opportunity to showcase our game at multiple conventions; Copenhagen Games Week, and Nordic Game Conference in Malmö, Sweden. It has been an insane ride, but now we are here!

Please give it a try! It can be finished in under an hour, but we hope it was worth the wait. I am never pouring this amount of hours into an unpaid project ever again.

- Thomas Markussen, Tech Lead (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomas-markussen-dev/)
